title: Persist active-search context settings

gates.name: Serving-context persistence tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/serving_control/test_realtime_context.py

verify.summary: Fresh Focus A verification passed the disposable migration round-trip, valid/restart persistence, revision increments, validation/duplicate rejection and cleanup, but a rejected quality-settings update partially persisted threshold and min-query quality after session commit while settings_revision remained unchanged at 4.

Attempt 2 fixed JSON-validation partial persistence, but fresh verification found the same partial unrevisioned mutation when timezone-naive timestamps are rejected after ORM assignment in reference-setting and active-date updates.

Fresh Attempt 3 verification passed hostile commit-after-rejection JSON and timestamp probes, valid/restart persistence, migration round-trip, cleanup, mypy, lint and owner/scope review; both prior partial-persistence defects are corrected.

Scheduler closed TASK-042 after Attempt 3 functional PASS; two bounded verification failures were corrected within the task scope and feature-level semantic verification remains scheduled at the FT-003 boundary.

evidence_required: realtime-search.md#active-search-context-persistence RED: the owner settings stores and provision/update path are absent; GREEN: the linear migration adds active date/revision fields and one reference_search_settings row per accepted key, serving_control alone validates and persists threshold/quality/calibration values, updates settings_revision atomically, and an isolated provision/update command produces deterministic task fixtures across restart; decisive comparison: migration round-trip, valid/invalid setting and revision-increment fixtures inspect only owner rows; artifact: focused pytest and migration output under .tasks/TASK-042-T2-FT-003-W1/.
purpose: Persist the owner-controlled values from which a later task resolves one immutable realtime context.
success_outcome: Serving-control stores and an isolated provision/update path durably hold the accepted active-search inputs without implementing resolution or readiness.
anti_goals: Do not implement context resolution/readiness, promo admission or the staff active-date API.
Do not add history, automatic rollover, a generic settings framework or client override.
Do not mutate FT-002 serving-revision selection behavior.

forbidden_scope: Immutable context resolver/readiness owned by TASK-060-T2-FT-003-W2
Staff active-date HTTP surface owned by FT-004
Display credentials and core Attempt persistence owned by other tasks
stop_conditions: Owner persistence requires changing the accepted serving-revision switch contract.
The stores cannot join the single linear Alembic stream.
A generic configuration platform or automatic lifecycle would be required.

constraints: Use the shared schema/Base/Alembic stream and current head.
The provision/update path is isolated and supplies deterministic test settings; it is not the FT-004 staff API.
Use task-owned disposable settings and restore/delete only those fixtures.
invariants: Every update increments the positive owner settings_revision atomically.
The browser cannot supply or override any persisted serving setting.
verification_targets: Migration and repository tests prove valid shape, restart persistence and isolated provision/update.
Ownership scan proves no client, promo or processing write path.
